shots.purpose: Put the warmth on screen first: a phone mid-charge glowing along its charge path
shots.claim: charging a phone always produces some waste heat
shots.evidence: full-bleed phone cross-section, cable entering, the charge path and battery glowing warm
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the glow reads as the subject, not decoration
shots.transition_reason: hard cut into the cell interior

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment-plate phone cross-section with glowing charge path and battery

one_second.relationship: the warmth lives along the charge path, not the screen

shots.purpose: Show what charging is: ions crossing the cell to store energy
shots.claim: charging stores energy by moving lithium ions between electrodes
shots.evidence: battery cross-section card: two electrodes with lithium ion dots crossing the gap, anode and cathode labelled
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the ion flow is the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut wider to the whole charge path

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram card of a battery cell cross-section with ion dots between electrodes

one_second.relationship: charging is ions moving electrode to electrode

shots.purpose: Show the full charge path and its resistance points
shots.claim: every part of the charge path has electrical resistance
shots.evidence: charge path card: plug, cable, charge chip and battery as a chain, each node with a resistor zigzag highlighted
shots.motion_reason: slow lateral drift along the chain, node to node
shots.transition_reason: cut into the split of power versus heat

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram of a charge chain with resistor zigzags at plug, cable, chip and cell

one_second.relationship: the current fights resistance at every stage

shots.purpose: Show power in versus heat out: the split that grows with charge rate
shots.claim: a few percent of charging power dissipates as heat; fast charging increases it
shots.evidence: split card: incoming charge power branching into a stored branch and a waste-heat branch drawn as heat waves, heat branch emphasized
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the branch split is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment split diagram: one power arrow branching into stored energy and heat waves

one_second.relationship: the same resistance takes more power as heat when more power flows

shots.purpose: Show the phone defending itself: the charge curve tapering under a thermal limit
shots.claim: phones reduce charging current when the battery runs hot
shots.evidence: charge curve card: current line stepping down over time beneath a dashed thermal limit line, temperature stripe below
shots.motion_reason: slow drift along the time axis revealing the taper

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment line chart card: tapering charge current under a dashed thermal limit

one_second.relationship: heat forces the phone to trade speed for safety

shots.purpose: Land the argument on the same phone, calm: warmth as the receipt for fast energy
shots.claim: charging heat is the unavoidable cost of moving energy fast
shots.evidence: dusk reprise of the opening phone, charge complete, cable coiled aside, one small heat wisp rising
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment-plate phone at rest, cable coiled, single heat wisp, dusk warmth

one_second.relationship: the heat was the price; the phone is fine
